title: plugbricks platform
description: What the user wants installed. Written by `plugbricks init`, `add` and `remove`; commit it. The resolved state lives in platform.lock.

name.description: Platform name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 2 to 40 characters.

router.description: The Cosmo router that plugbricks adds in front of the subgraphs of the installed bricks. There is none while no brick serves a subgraph.

port.description: Docker Compose: the port the router is published on, on 127.0.0.1 only. Kubernetes: the port of its ClusterIP Service. 1024 to 65535 (the router never runs as root).

bricks.description: Installed bricks, keyed by the name in their plugin.json.

source.description: Directory the brick was added from, relative to this file, with / separators.
